t: You're at Mornington Crescent tube station, in Somers Town, named after the nearby street. It sits on the Charing Cross branch of the Northern line, between Camden Town and Euston, in fare zone 2. The station was designed by Leslie Green, the architect behind many of the Underground's central London stations from the early 1900s. His signature look is oxblood red glazed blocks, pillars, and semicircular first-floor windows, with patterned tiled interiors inside.
